jobPostingInfo.title: Site Operations Manager (Facilities Management)
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Job Location

BANGKOK GENERAL OFFICE

Job Description

Overview


Do you like a hands-on and fast-paced role leading and transforming P&G's Facilities and Workplace?

Are you a creative individual with a problem-solving and service-oriented mindset?

Do you have a passion for innovation and a desire to learn and grow continuously?

If so, then this opportunity is the one you have been looking for!


In the Digital Workplace and Facilities Services team, we own the sites and are the guardians of employee experience. This role is

responsible for leading workplace and facilities management of P&G Sites in Thailand, working with a diverse team of internal and external

partners to ensure a seamless office experience. We deliver productivity and care to our colleagues through all our service touch points every

single day. We help to accelerate business value creation for the company by driving site projects with agility, cost effectiveness, and quality.


We strategize and lead a portfolio of projects and initiatives catered to delivering the best workplace experience.


Your Team

You will report to the Workplace Services Site Leader and will be working with multi-functional partners across Thailand Sites. You will also be accountable for a large team of P&G's external workplace vendors and suppliers.


What Success Looks Like

As a Workplace Services – Site Operations Leader, you are expected to lead a team that will run the day-to-day operations of our workplace

and ensure that our employees are able to perform at their peak in our offices. You and your team will be responsible to deliver Workplace

Facilities and IT Projects to continuously uplift employee experience and meet business needs.


Role Responsibilities

  • Work with the local facilities management team to ensure that the physical workplace and all related services are operating
  • efficiently to deliver the best employee experience. This includes overseeing the delivery of hard services and soft services.
    Work with the local IT operations team to ensure that the site IT equipment and processes are operating efficiently and is
  • enabling productivity for all employees (e.g. PCs, video conferencing devices, etc).
  • Implement tools that will help automate controls and track KPI’s where necessary as part of continuous improvement
  • Support IT and Facilities priority projects based on business needs
  • Support HSE, Engineering, Physical Security, and Sustainability efforts at the site

Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s/ Master’s Degree in Facilities Management, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • Strong project management skills / proven experience in leading projects from definition through execution
  • Ownership with executional excellence and discipline
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Facilities Management and Employee Engagement skills and experiences are an added advantage

About us

We produce globally recognized brands, and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders are able to lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories, and functions. We serve consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Downy®, Gillette®, Head & Shoulders®, Herbal Essences®, Oral-B®, Pampers®, Olay®, Always®, Pantene®, Safeguard®, SKII®, Ambi Pur® and more. Our community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide.


Visit http://www.pg.com to know more.
